CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, June 4, 2025
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Fabiola Hernandez, Vice Chairmember  Luis Gonzalez, Commissioner
Luis Alvarez, Commissioner  Axzel Roman, Commissioner

  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, June 4, 2025 at 6:00 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Chair Winford.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Commissioner Alvarez
  Commissioner Gonzalez
  Chairmember Winford
ABSENT
  2 Commissioner Roman
  Vice Chairmember Hernandez
AGENDA ORGANIZATION
There were no changes made to the agenda organization.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)
1.  Recommendation to approve Resolution No. 2025­002 ­ recommending Planning Commission
  approval of Conditional Use Permit (CUP) No. 2025­0042, approving an amendment to case
  PLNG2014­0108­SIGN, for property located at 11871 Carson Street (The Gardens Casino). The
  project allows the Gardens Casino to upgrade the existing double­sided pylon sign by replacing it
  with a larger LED display.
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Tonya Pace, Senior Planner, provided the staff report.

  Rod Wilson, President and CEO, EMI Digital Signs, applicant, spoke.

  Chair Winford spoke.

  Commissioner Alvarez spoke.

  Commissioner Gonzalez spoke.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Gonzalez, seconded by Commissioner Alvarez, to approve
 PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  recommendation and adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 2025­002.
 REGULAR MEETING
 JUNE 4, 2025  Page 1
  The motion carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 3; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Winford
  NOES: 0;
   Rod Wilson, President and CEO, EMI Digital Signs, applicant, spoke.

  Chair Winford spoke.

  Commissioner Alvarez spoke.

  Commissioner Gonzalez spoke.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Gonzalez, seconded by Commissioner Alvarez, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 2025­002.

  The motion carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 3; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Winford
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 2; Roman, Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 3–0–2–0

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of Wednesday,
  March 5, 2025.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner Gonzalez, to adopt the
  Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Winford
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 2; Roman, Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 3–0–2–0

C.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Staff Reports.

D.  ORAL COMMISSIONER REPORT(S)

Chair Winford praised Public Works staff for the cleanliness of the main boulevard corridors.

E.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:24 PM.
